name: step tracker above a file upload card
looks: A three-segment progress bar (each segment its own colour, labelled "1 Add", "2 Edit", "3 Watch") sits above a step headline and a drop-zone card. A file row slides in with its name and page count, and a green check confirms it as the first segment fills.
build: timeline-scrubber-hud's bar, simplified to three discrete labelled segments instead of a continuous playhead, each filling and ticking its label on completion; the card is a glass-ui-flow drop zone with the file row sliding up and a check icon popping in on back.out.
sound: A soft whoosh as the file row arrives, a chime on the check.
prompt: Show a short, labelled step tracker with three segments above a plain upload card. Let a file (or any single input) slide into the card and get confirmed with a check mark the moment the first segment fills, so progress and action read together.
